infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Detail uses your location to find nearby cleaners.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you choose to go online as a cleaner, Detail shares your location with the service while you are online and on an active booking so nearby customers can be matched and customers can follow your arrival.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take profile and portfolio photos, add photos to bookings, capture cleaning progress or completion, and share photos in chat.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Detail uses the microphone only during a voice call you start or answer with your booking partner.
